title: Subscriptions
subtitle: Plan requests from dealerships and every subscription term on the platform. A term starts as Awaiting payment, which grants no listing quota — the dealership can only publish once the subscription is active.

requests.caption: Plan requests from dealerships
requests.loadFailed: Could not load the plan requests

empty.title: No requests here
empty.hint: Dealerships that ask for a plan appear in this queue, longest wait first.

subs.caption: All subscription terms
subs.pendingPaymentCallout: Awaiting payment grants no listing quota. A dealership with an assigned but unpaid term still cannot publish — the quota starts when the subscription invoice is paid and the term turns active.
subs.noSnapshotHint: This term predates price snapshotting, so no agreed price was recorded on it.

empty.title: No subscriptions match
empty.hint: Change the status filter, or assign a package to a dealership.

assign.title: Assign a package
assign.description: The term is created awaiting payment and grants no quota until the subscription invoice is paid.
assign.dealerPlaceholder: Search by name, slug or TRN
assign.dealerSearchFailed: The dealership directory could not be searched
assign.dealerIdHint: Use this if you cannot search the directory — assigning a package does not require directory access.
assign.termMonthsHint: Leave empty to use the package's own term. 1 to 60.
assign.priceOverrideHint: Leave empty to charge the package price.
assign.snapshotNote: The package and the price are snapshotted onto this term. Re-pricing the package later never changes what this dealership pays — and editing this term afterwards is not possible, so set the negotiated price now.
assign.summary: {{package}} — {{price}} for {{months}} months, snapshotted onto this term.

approve.title: Approve the request from {{dealer}}
approve.description: They asked for {{package}} at {{price}}. You can grant different terms.
approve.pendingPaymentNote: Approving creates the term awaiting payment. The dealership can publish once the subscription invoice is paid.

decline.title: Decline the request from {{dealer}}
decline.description: The reason is sent to the dealership, so write it for them to read.
decline.placeholder: e.g. we need the trade licence verified before granting a plan

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the subscription for {{dealer}}
cancelDialog.description: Choose whether the dealership keeps what it paid for, or loses it now.
cancelDialog.atPeriodEnd: At the end of the term
cancelDialog.atPeriodEndHint: They keep publishing until {{date}}, then the term is not renewed.
cancelDialog.immediateHint: The term ends now and every live listing this dealership has is paused.
cancelDialog.confirmScheduled: {{dealer}} will keep their quota until {{date}}, and the term will not renew.
cancelDialog.confirmImmediate: {{dealer}} loses their quota now and all of their live listings are paused immediately.

toast.packagesFailed: Could not load the package tiers
toast.assigned: Package assigned — the term is awaiting payment
toast.approved: Request approved — the term is awaiting payment
toast.declined: Request declined and the dealership notified
toast.cancelScheduled: The subscription will end at the end of the term
toast.cancelledNow: Subscription cancelled and live listings paused
